description: This file defines the ManageAccountAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Account objects in an Android application. It manages the creation and binding of view holders for account items, handles updates to the account list, and tracks the currently selected account.

classes.name: ManageAccountAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for managing and displaying a list of Account objects, including handling selection and updates.

methods.name: ManageAccountAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a callback and sets stable IDs.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the account at the specified position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ManageAccountViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds account data to the view holder and indicates if it is the current local account.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of accounts in the list.

methods.name: setLocalAccounts
methods.description: Updates the list of accounts and refreshes the view.

methods.name: setCurrentLocalAccount
methods.description: Sets the currently selected account and refreshes the view.
